articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz reviewed the India-Germany Strategic Partnership, noting progress and potential from the India-EU FTA. They discussed global developments, promoting peace, and strengthening cooperation in defense, technology, and green energy.

articles.headline: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia CEO Role; Shares Surge
articles.summary: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as Nvidia CEO after a brief resignation, with shares surging over 30% and adding $900 billion in market value. The board's decision, supported by lobbying from influential figures, aims to stabilize the company and maintain its AI leadership.

articles.headline: Google Cloud India cuts 30 roles amid restructuring
articles.summary: Google Cloud India clarified it eliminated around 30 roles in the country as part of an organizational restructuring and work re-prioritization, denying speculation of large-scale layoffs.

articles.headline: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Smashes World Records with 53-Ball Double Century
articles.summary: 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 204 off 53 balls for India A against UAE, setting a new record for the fastest List A double century with 28 sixes. He reached his hundred in 28 balls.

articles.headline: BJP-SAD alliance revived for Punjab polls; Shah calls SAD 'big brother'
articles.summary: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) have renewed their alliance for the Punjab assembly elections, marking SAD's return to the NDA after a six-year separation. Amit Shah acknowledged SAD as the 'big brother' and claimant to the CM post, aiming to address state issues.

articles.headline: Karnataka Explores Japan’s Waste-to-Energy Model for Urban Refuse
articles.summary: A Karnataka delegation studied Japan’s waste-to-energy technology at the Maishima Incineration Plant to manage urban waste and convert it into electricity, aiming to adopt advanced pollution-reduction systems.

articles.headline: Mehbooba Mufti stopped near Sheshnag Lake amid construction row
articles.summary: Former J&K CM Mehbooba Mufti was prevented by police from visiting the Sheshnag Lake area amid controversy over construction work near the ecologically fragile site, raising concerns about environmental damage.

articles.headline: IKEA India Revenue Grows 14%, Targets Profitability by FY29
articles.summary: IKEA India's FY26 revenue rose 14% to ~2,100 crore, with e-commerce growing 28%. The company aims for profitability by FY29 and plans to expand to 30 stores by 2030, having narrowed its operating loss.

articles.headline: Spielberg to direct Western with Paul Thomas Anderson script
articles.summary: Steven Spielberg will direct a Western film written by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy, and Mark Rylance, based on Kevin Barry's novel. A 2028 release is targeted.

articles.headline: Ukraine confirms hitting Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
articles.summary: Ukraine's President Zelensky confirmed responsibility for a drone strike on the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland, deeming it a legitimate military target.

articles.headline: US govt set to hit India, China & 14 others with new tariffs
articles.summary: The US Trade Representative is preparing to impose new tariffs on imports from India, China, and 14 other countries following a probe into alleged excess industrial capacity.

articles.headline: Karnataka may seek SC nod for elephant contraception
articles.summary: Karnataka plans to seek Supreme Court permission to use non-lethal immunocontraception to manage its growing elephant population, which currently numbers 6,395.

articles.headline: Tata Sons weighs stake purchase, buybacks to unlock liquidity for SP
articles.summary: Tata Sons is considering options like stake purchase or buybacks to provide liquidity to Shapoorji Pallonji Group, its largest minority shareholder.

articles.headline: Karnataka govt bans 'Basava Mantapa' book by Ravi Hanj
articles.summary: The Karnataka government has banned Ravi Hanj's book 'Basava Mantapa', prohibiting its circulation and authorizing police to seize copies.

articles.headline: Diljit Dosanjh concert in Bengaluru receives bomb threat
articles.summary: Authorities received a bomb threat email targeting Diljit Dosanjh's upcoming concert in Bengaluru on Nov 29, prompting a police investigation and high alert.

articles.headline: Tata, Hyundai, Audi hike car prices over rising costs
articles.summary: Major automakers including Tata Motors, Hyundai, and Audi are increasing car prices from December 2026 to January 2027 due to sustained input and commodity cost pressures.

articles.headline: Credit card spending surpasses ATM withdrawals in India
articles.summary: For the first time in October 2026, credit card spending in India exceeded ATM withdrawals, indicating a significant shift in payment patterns.

articles.headline: Dalai Lama allotted bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi
articles.summary: The Centre has allocated a Type-7 government bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi to Tibetan spiritual leader the Dalai Lama, providing a permanent base for his visits.

articles.headline: Govt plans mandatory battery storage for rooftop solar
articles.summary: The government proposes mandatory battery storage for larger rooftop solar installations (over 10 kW), requiring capacity equivalent to 20% of daily generation.

articles.headline: Chinese satellites monitored India’s western coast during Op Sindoor
articles.summary: Three Chinese surveillance satellites monitored India's western coast, particularly Gujarat, during Operation Sindoor last year, a report revealed.

articles.headline: Five of family die in SUV-truck collision in Bihar
articles.summary: Five family members died in a head-on collision between their SUV and a coal-laden truck in Bihar. Four others were injured.

articles.headline: Uttarakhand HC extends perks to retired judges
articles.summary: Uttarakhand High Court extended protocol, medical, transport, and accommodation facilities to retired judges and their families, on par with serving judges.

articles.headline: PT Usha out of race for IOA president
articles.summary: PT Usha will not seek a second term as Indian Olympic Association (IOA) president, with her nomination not being approved by the deadline.

articles.headline: BJP-Akali Dal seal poll alliance for Punjab elections
articles.summary: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal announced an alliance for the upcoming Punjab Assembly elections, marking SAD's return to the NDA after six years. The alliance aims to address Punjab's issues.

articles.headline: Birth detail mismatch in documents flagged
articles.summary: A mismatch in Saurav Das's birth details across Aadhaar, passport, and birth certificate led the Chennai passport office to initiate a fresh verification.

articles.headline: Kuki, Naga groups appeal for Christmas truce in Manipur
articles.summary: Kuki and Naga leaders have appealed for a Christmas truce to halt the ongoing violence between communities in Manipur.

articles.headline: Hasina plans Dec 16 return; Dhaka signals only extradition
articles.summary: Former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina plans to return on Dec 16, but Dhaka indicated she can only be brought back via extradition, not regular arrangements.

articles.headline: Bengaluru's LED streetlight installation nears completion
articles.summary: Nearly 90% of LED streetlight installation work across six assembly constituencies in Bengaluru Central City Corporation is completed.

articles.headline: Woman requires 3 surgeries after failed pregnancy treatment; doctor fined
articles.summary: A doctor was ordered to pay Rs 2 lakh compensation for medical negligence after a woman required three surgeries due to complications from failed pregnancy treatment.

articles.headline: Bengaluru Blue Line Metro trials start, public launch in 8 months
articles.summary: Trial runs for Bengaluru's Namma Metro Blue Line have begun, but public operations are expected in 7-8 months due to pending signalling and safety inspections.

articles.headline: ASHA workers continue protest, reject CM's appeal
articles.summary: ASHA workers rejected Karnataka CM's appeal to end their protest, demanding written assurances and discussion on their demands for better wages and working conditions.

articles.headline: Woman and daughter drown in pond near Chikkamagaluru
articles.summary: A woman and her 14-year-old daughter drowned in a pond near Chikkamagaluru; the family suspects they accidentally fell while washing hands.

articles.headline: HC refuses relief to doctor accused of aiding Bangladeshis
articles.summary: Karnataka HC denied relief to a doctor accused of helping Bangladeshi nationals obtain Aadhaar cards by attesting their address-proof certificates.

articles.headline: HC allows probe against Jayanagar MLA over voter deletion allegations
articles.summary: The Karnataka High Court permitted police to continue the probe against Jayanagar MLA C.K. Ramamurthy concerning alleged misuse of Form-7 applications to remove Muslim voters.

articles.headline: Akshaya Patra's model discussed at UN forum
articles.summary: Akshaya Patra Foundation presented its public-private partnership model for school feeding at a UN forum, emphasizing nutrition security and social safety nets.

articles.headline: IISc prof wins Tata prize for green fertiliser tech
articles.summary: IISc professor Lakshminarayana Rao received the Tata Transformation Prize for developing plasma-activated water (PAW) as a sustainable alternative to nitrogen fertilizers.

articles.headline: HDK ducks cyber police notice, flies to Delhi
articles.summary: Hassan cybercrime police attempted to serve a notice on former CM H.D. Kumaraswamy regarding corruption allegations, but he reportedly flew to Delhi.

articles.headline: KEA's exam system praised by central task force
articles.summary: Karnataka Examinations Authority's transparent exam practices, including use of CCTV and scanned OMR sheets, have impressed the Nandan Nilekani-led task force for public examinations reforms.

articles.headline: How States, Cos Can Help Mid-Career Women Return To Work
articles.summary: This article outlines strategies for state governments and organizations to support mid-career women's return to the workforce through childcare, flexible roles, and inclusive policies.

articles.headline: Real Madrid want to tie down Bellingham until 2031
articles.summary: Real Madrid aims to extend Jude Bellingham's contract until 2031, securing his long-term future amidst strong interest from other clubs.

articles.headline: US to host Copa America in 2028
articles.summary: The United States will host the Copa America tournament in 2028, marking its second consecutive time as host.

articles.headline: Gukesh survives close call, splits point in opener
articles.summary: Indian Grandmaster D Gukesh drew his first match against Javokhir Sindarov in the FIDE World Championship 2026 after a tense battle.

articles.headline: Youth welfare may be at heart of Eco Survey
articles.summary: The upcoming Economic Survey for 2026-27 may focus on youth welfare, job creation, and AI's impact on labor, following concerns about employment and fiscal pressures.
